description:
Create a new operator-owned discount coupon.

The coupon owns its binding: ``tool_ids`` names the tools it
discounts, and re-pricing a tool never touches it. A coupon bound
to no tool discounts nothing, however many patrons redeem it.

name.description:
The catchy code patrons type to redeem
(operator-scoped uniqueness).

tool_ids.description:
The tools this coupon discounts — tool ids or MCP
tool names, or ``["*"]`` for every tool priced above zero.

total_uses.description:
Aggregate cap across all patrons (default None =
unlimited).

uses_per_patron.description:
How many tool calls one patron can claim the
discount on (default 1; pass null/None for unlimited
within the window).

valid_from.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon becomes active.

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the coupon expires.

name: roastify_mint_coupon
title: Roastify Mint Coupon
